principle: No source payload is deleted or rewritten. Each original portfolio item is preserved verbatim under sourceData while a recommended public entity type is proposed.

sourceData.title: Projectr
sourceData.productType: constructive media network and structured knowledge platform
sourceData.description: A constructive media network for creating, sharing, revising, and coordinating projects, plans, goals, procedures, learning paths, evidence, progress, and reusable public knowledge. Its primary objects are constructive and revisable rather than disposable posts.
publicValue: Turns attention into structured agency and reusable knowledge.
Supports collaborative planning, learning, documentation, and public problem solving.
Creates a durable home for constructive media rather than engagement-only media.
incomePotential: Subscriptions for advanced workspaces and organizational use.
Creator, education, community, and enterprise tooling.

sourceData.title: YouTube Knowledge Explorer
sourceData.productType: learning wrapper and educational media tool
sourceData.description: A learning layer over YouTube that turns playlists, channels, and selected videos into structured learning paths with notes, dependencies, progress, summaries, and explicit reasons for what to watch next.
publicValue: Converts video feeds into navigable learning environments.
Helps teachers, creators, families, and independent learners organize durable knowledge.
Provides an accessible on-ramp into the larger Projectr ecosystem.

sourceData.title: Cross-Platform Bookshelf
sourceData.productType: personal knowledge and media organizer
sourceData.description: A structured bookshelf for videos, articles, podcasts, books, documents, and courses that preserves why an item was saved, where it belongs, the user's intended use, progress, relationships, and resulting knowledge or action.
publicValue: Preserves learning intent instead of merely accumulating links.
Connects media consumption to projects, goals, and action.
Reduces fragmentation across platforms and formats.

sourceData.title: Constructive Media Protocol
sourceData.productType: constructive knowledge and media infrastructure
sourceData.description: A protocol layer for identifying, attributing, versioning, relating, transporting, forking, correcting, rewarding, and preserving constructive media and public knowledge across systems.
publicValue: Makes constructive knowledge portable, composable, and correctable.
Preserves attribution, lineage, and revision across platform boundaries.
Provides infrastructure for durable public knowledge rather than isolated content silos.

sourceData.title: Barter and Capacity Exchange
sourceData.productType: civic-economic exchange network
sourceData.description: A structured exchange network for matching underused goods, services, time, tools, space, transport, care, expertise, inventory, and productive capacity to represented human and organizational need.
publicValue: Makes underused capacity and unmet need mutually legible.
Supports exchange where conventional money is absent, scarce, or an incomplete representation of value.
Creates public-interest infrastructure for neighborhoods, mutual-aid groups, nonprofits, and small organizations.
incomePotential: Transaction, matching, or administrative service fees where appropriate.
Municipal, nonprofit, cooperative, and community deployments.

sourceData.title: Barter Ledger
sourceData.productType: accounting, provenance, credit, and settlement layer
sourceData.description: A durable accounting layer for exchange, reciprocal obligation, contribution, portable reputation, mutual credit, and settlement. Blockchain is treated as one possible implementation rather than the product's purpose.
publicValue: Creates legible and durable exchange records.
Supports trust, reciprocity, and contribution accounting across communities.
Allows the ledger architecture to be selected by the invariants of the exchange system.
sourceData.designConstraint: Choose the ledger that preserves the economic invariant; do not invent an economic invariant to justify the ledger.

sourceData.title: Need and Capacity Map
sourceData.productType: public-interest matching and coordination tool
sourceData.description: A bounded tool for representing underused resources, unmet needs, matching constraints, and trusted organizations capable of closing the gap before attempting to build a complete alternative economic system.
publicValue: Provides immediate coordination value without requiring a new currency.
Supports neighborhood, nonprofit, school, disaster-response, and mutual-aid use.
Generates evidence about what a larger exchange system must preserve.
incomePotential: Integration with resource-management and civic systems.

sourceData.title: Child-Safe Video Calling
sourceData.productType: bounded mobile communication utility
sourceData.description: A video-call environment that allows a caregiver to hand a young child a live call without exposing the rest of the phone or allowing random touches to hang up, change settings, open applications, send messages, or make purchases.
publicValue: Preserves safe family connection for children too young to operate a general-purpose phone.
Demonstrates safety through explicit negative capability and bounded interaction.
Creates an accessible consumer example of boundary-first interface design.
incomePotential: Partnerships with communication, accessibility, and family-service providers.
sourceData.designConstraint: The child receives the intended human connection while irrelevant operational control remains inaccessible.

sourceData.title: Family Presence Mode
sourceData.productType: caregiver-mediated communication and accessibility environment
sourceData.description: A reduced and trusted communication environment for children, elderly users, people with cognitive or motor impairments, hospitalized family members, and others who need human connection without general-device complexity.
publicValue: Expands safe communication beyond the child-use case.
Preserves human presence while removing irrelevant operational complexity.
Supports accessibility, caregiving, and remote family connection.
incomePotential: Licensed communication modes for device or platform providers.

sourceData.title: Single-Purpose Phone Modes
sourceData.productType: bounded mobile interaction framework
sourceData.description: A framework for temporarily turning a general-purpose phone into a bounded appliance for one trusted activity, such as emergency contact, medical instruction, school pickup, elder check-in, navigation, appointments, tickets, or household tasks.
publicValue: Reduces accidental action, confusion, distraction, and misuse.
Creates accessible interfaces for users who do not need the full device surface.
Provides a reusable architecture for a family of small public-value applications.

sourceData.title: Corpus Forge
sourceData.productType: research operations and corpus stewardship workbench
sourceData.stage: operational internal workflow moving toward product
sourceData.description: A workbench for turning notes, documents, conversations, models, and experiments into a traceable, versioned research system through ingestion, source preservation, claim extraction, artifact classification, contradiction tracking, maturity control, provenance, review gates, and replacement documents.
publicValue: Turns unstructured bodies of work into traceable and criticizable knowledge systems.
Preserves provenance, maturity, dependency, and replacement history.
Provides infrastructure for responsible publication and institutional memory.

migrationNotes: Overloaded source entry: separate the Corpus Forge method/program from any maintained Workbench product.

sourceData.title: Integrated Corpus Forge Workbench
sourceData.productType: AI-assisted research and authoring environment
sourceData.description: An integrated workspace in which chat, source material, documents, claim ledgers, citations, and structured corpus transformations remain connected. Conversation can refine the durable corpus instead of disappearing into a chat transcript.
publicValue: Keeps AI assistance tied to sources, provenance, and durable artifacts.
Allows claims and revisions to move directly into governed research structures.
Makes the workbench rather than the chat interface the center of knowledge production.
sourceData.designConstraint: The chatbot is not the product; the durable and governed transformation of the corpus is the product.

sourceData.title: Boundary-First Engineering Workbench
sourceData.productType: software and systems design workbench
sourceData.description: A professional environment for extracting actors, permissions, domain objects, inputs, outputs, boundaries, invariants, admissibility rules, failure modes, interfaces, closure conditions, and repair ownership before architecture hardens.
publicValue: Makes domain assumptions and responsibility structures visible before implementation.
Produces inspectable domain maps, contracts, decision logs, risk ledgers, and executable skeletons.
Reduces costly architectural drift and hidden failure.

sourceData.title: Agency Audit Platform
sourceData.productType: AI, software, and institutional governance assessment tool
sourceData.description: A structured assessment platform for determining who can act, who authorized the action, what meaningful options remain, who can challenge or reverse it, who bears the consequence, and who owns repair.
publicValue: Makes delegated agency and responsibility chains inspectable.
Supports governance review of AI, software, organizations, and institutional processes.
Turns Constructive Humanist Agentics into a repeatable assessment practice.

sourceData.title: Claim and Evidence Ledger
sourceData.productType: research, policy, and governance evidence infrastructure
sourceData.stage: module partially embodied in Corpus Forge
sourceData.description: A focused system for tracking claims, sources, evidence, assumptions, counterevidence, maturity, ownership, review, supersession, and permitted public wording.
publicValue: Prevents claims from silently outrunning their evidence.
Supports traceable correction and responsible public communication.
Provides a smaller independent product surface extracted from Corpus Forge.
incomePotential: Policy, research, assurance, and investigative deployments.

sourceData.title: Secure Multistream Video Storage
sourceData.productType: cloud video storage, encoding, and replay infrastructure
sourceData.description: A technical system for efficiently encoding, storing, securing, and replaying multiple synchronized video streams through an encoder core, durable container, API, SDK, benchmark suite, and replay module.
publicValue: Improves the storage and retrieval of synchronized media evidence and experiences.
Creates a concrete systems-engineering asset with benchmarkable performance.
Can support safety, research, media, and institutional recording use cases.
incomePotential: Licensing or acquisition by cloud, storage, or media providers.

sourceData.title: Cryptonium
sourceData.productType: secure document signing, provenance, and trusted storage
sourceData.stage: prior architecture requiring current asset review
sourceData.description: A cryptographic signing and storage system for authorship, authorization, tamper evidence, institutional records, publication lineage, and legally consequential documents.
publicValue: Strengthens document provenance, authorization, and tamper evidence.
Supports trustworthy institutional records and publication lineage.
Provides a technical bridge between provenance doctrine and executable infrastructure.

sourceData.title: Macro-Deck Control Dashboard
sourceData.productType: desktop and mobile automation utility
sourceData.description: A customizable control surface containing buttons, switches, knobs, timers, scripts, status widgets, and automation triggers for personal or professional workflows.
publicValue: Makes complex workflows visible and directly controllable.
Supports accessibility, productivity, and custom operational environments.
Provides a bounded utility with a clear engineering surface.

sourceData.title: Windows Terminal Workspace Manager
sourceData.productType: developer continuity utility
sourceData.stage: prior concept or implementation requiring inventory
sourceData.description: A developer utility for preserving and restoring terminal tabs, directories, commands, labels, themes, and project layouts so meaningful work can resume with less reconstruction.
publicValue: Preserves operational context across interrupted work.
Reduces setup friction and state loss for developers.
Demonstrates the portfolio's broader interest in continuity and recoverable working state.

sourceData.title: Boundary-First Chess Software
sourceData.productType: educational analysis, interactive examples, and game-learning software
sourceData.description: Interactive software derived from Boundary-First Chess, including position and move classifiers, worked examples, teaching tools, curriculum, and possible analysis interfaces that make boundary reasoning visible in a familiar game.
publicValue: Provides an accessible on-ramp into boundary reasoning.
Improves chess pedagogy for beginners and casual viewers.
Creates a public demonstration of representational mechanics in use.

migrationNotes: Source describes a family of software opportunities; concrete products should be split only when separately scoped.

sourceData.title: Weather@Home and Boundary-First Weather
sourceData.productType: local weather modeling, simulation, sensing, and public infrastructure
sourceData.description: A product and research lane spanning local forecasting, simulation, environmental sensing, distributed computation, and public weather infrastructure shaped by boundary-aware modeling.
publicValue: Improves local environmental legibility and public access to weather intelligence.
Provides a demanding testbed for dynamic models, uncertainty, and infrastructure.
Connects foundational research to an immediate public-interest domain.

migrationNotes: Source describes a research-heavy product lane; likely requires program plus one or more concrete product/testbed entities.

sourceData.title: Home Boundary Maintenance OS
sourceData.productType: household maintenance and continuity system
sourceData.stage: aligned portfolio concept not yet confirmed as active asset
sourceData.description: A household system for tracking assets, maintenance intervals, warranties, repairs, replacement parts, service history, inspections, and early failure signals.
publicValue: Makes household maintenance state and responsibility legible.
Supports prevention, continuity, and repair rather than crisis response.
Applies boundary-first maintenance principles to ordinary life.

sourceData.title: Infrastructure Maintenance Ledger
sourceData.productType: public and institutional infrastructure accountability tool
sourceData.stage: aligned portfolio concept not yet confirmed as active asset
sourceData.description: A system for tracing infrastructure assets, condition, deferred maintenance, budgets, inspections, ownership, consequence, and repair responsibility.
publicValue: Makes deferred maintenance and responsibility visible.
Connects public spending, asset condition, and repair history.
Supports institutional memory and public accountability.
incomePotential: Public infrastructure consulting and data services.

sourceData.title: Boundary-First Soccer
sourceData.productType: spatial game analysis and educational software
sourceData.description: A possible extension of boundary-first analysis into spatial pressure, possession, closure, transition, and team shape in soccer.
publicValue: Tests whether the chess pedagogy transports into a dynamic team domain.
Offers a familiar public on-ramp into spatial and collective boundary reasoning.
Could generate comparative evidence for the wider discipline.

migrationNotes: Present as an early research/on-ramp project, not as an available product.
